spots.name: Lake Eola Park
spots.blurb: Downtown lake loop with swan boats, the fountain and city views
spots.blurbEs: Lago del centro con paseo, botes en forma de cisne, la fuente y vistas de la ciudad

spots.name: Orlando Science Center
spots.blurb: Four floors of hands-on science exhibits, plus a giant-screen dome theater
spots.blurbEs: Cuatro pisos de exhibiciones científicas interactivas y un cine de pantalla gigante

spots.name: Orlando Museum of Art
spots.blurb: The city's art museum, with American and contemporary collections
spots.blurbEs: El museo de arte de la ciudad, con colecciones de arte estadounidense y contemporáneo

spots.name: Harry P. Leu Gardens
spots.blurb: Botanical garden and historic house museum near downtown
spots.blurbEs: Jardín botánico y casa museo histórica cerca del centro

spots.name: Charles Hosmer Morse Museum of American Art
spots.blurb: World's largest collection of Louis Comfort Tiffany glass, including his chapel
spots.blurbEs: La mayor colección del mundo de vidrio de Louis Comfort Tiffany, incluida su capilla

spots.name: Loch Haven Park
spots.blurb: Lakeside park that ties together the city's museums and theaters
spots.blurbEs: Parque junto a lagos que reúne los museos y teatros de la ciudad
